name: media.encode
title: Video encoder (delivery)
summary: Encode a video with explicit quality, bitrate, size, scaling and audio controls, including fit-to-N-MB two-pass encoding and named delivery presets.
description: The delivery encoder. It never guesses: quality (crf or bitrate), scale caps, fps, audio codec/bitrate and colour are explicit inputs. Use target_size_mb to hit a byte budget with a two-pass x264/x265 encode, or a preset from presets/encode/ for a known platform. When the audio codec is copy the stream is not re-encoded and the fit-to-size budget reserves its real source bitrate instead of audio.bitrate_k, so prefer audio: {codec: "copy"} when the source audio is already AAC at the delivery rate (it also avoids a second lossy pass). Colour is converted only when asked: with video.color set (the default 'bt709') the scale filter maps in_color_matrix=auto/in_range=auto to the requested matrix and TV range, with matching tags; video.color null leaves colour untouched. Scaling never upscales and keeps the aspect ratio.

input.description: Video file to encode: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

replace_audio.description: Use this file's audio instead of the input's audio. Omit to keep the input audio (if any).

preset.description: Name of an encode preset under presets/encode/ (master, web-720p, fit-size, telegram-video, instagram-reel). Explicit fields in this request override the preset.

video.description: Video stream settings. All optional; absent means the encoder default, except that with no crf, bitrate_k or target_size_mb the tool uses crf 18.

codec.description: Video encoder, e.g. libx264, libx265, libvpx-vp9. Default libx264.

preset.description: Encoder speed preset, e.g. ultrafast, slow, veryslow. Default medium.

crf.description: Constant quality (lower is better/bigger). Ignored when bitrate_k or target_size_mb is set.

bitrate_k.description: Target video bitrate in kbit/s. Overrides crf.

maxrate_k.description: Maximum video bitrate in kbit/s. bufsize_k defaults to 2x this.

maxrate_factor.description: With target_size_mb, maxrate_k = computed video kbps x this factor. Default 1.75 when omitted.

bufsize_k.description: Rate-control buffer in kbit/s. Defaults to 2x maxrate_k.

level.description: Codec level, e.g. '4.2'. A string so decimals like 4.2 survive.

closed_gop.description: Close every GOP (-flags +cgop), required by some social platforms.

tune.description: Encoder tuning, e.g. film, animation, fastdecode.

color.description: Output colour matrix, e.g. bt709, bt601, smpte240m. Adds an auto->target colour conversion plus matching tags. null adds no conversion and no tags.

audio.description: Audio stream settings applied to the mapped audio (input or replace_audio).

codec.description: Audio encoder, e.g. aac, libopus, copy. Default aac. Use copy when the source audio is already AAC at the delivery rate: the stream is not re-encoded and the fit-to-size budget reserves its real source bitrate (0 when the source has no audio stream).

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz (-ar). Omit to keep the source rate.

channels.description: Output channel count (-ac). Omit to keep the source layout.

scale.description: Scaling. Explicit width/height win; otherwise max_long_side and max_width cap the size, never upscale, and keep the aspect ratio (the unknown side becomes -2).

width.description: Exact output width. With height omitted, height is derived (-2).

height.description: Exact output height. With width omitted, width is derived (-2).

max_long_side.description: Fit the longer side to this many pixels (never upscales).

max_width.description: Cap the output width to this many pixels (never upscales).

fps.description: Output frame rate (-r). Omit to keep the source rate.

two_pass.description: Run a two-pass encode (libx264/libx265 only; ignored for other codecs). Implied by target_size_mb.

target_size_mb.description: Fit the output under this many megabytes (1 MB = 10^6 bytes). Computes a bitrate and runs a two-pass x264/x265 encode.

size_margin.description: Fraction of the target bitrate held back for container overhead when fitting to a size. Default 0.04.

name.description: Output file name inside the job output, matching ^[\w.-]+$. Default video.mp4.

size_bytes.description: Size of the written file in bytes.

duration_s.description: Duration of the output in seconds.

video_bitrate_k.description: Video stream bitrate in kbit/s, from the output probe when available.

audio_bitrate_k.description: Audio bitrate in kbit/s used in the fit-to-size budget: the real source stream bitrate when audio.codec is copy (0 when the source has no audio stream), else audio.bitrate_k.

passes.description: Number of encoding passes used for the final attempt (1 or 2).

attempts.description: Number of encode attempts (2 when the first fit-to-size attempt was over target).

examples.title: Scale to 320 px and replace audio
